title: Pricing Desk Memorandum: The Residential Electricity Supply Renewal Rate
content:
**1. Starting rate.** The renewal rate of a Residential Electricity Supply agreement starts from the offered renewal rate stated on the latest renewal notice on the agreement, the notice with the latest notice date whether it is an initial renewal notice or a final options notice. The offered renewal rate is read in cents per kWh to two decimal places.

**2. Assembly.** Every per-kWh reduction on the renewal rate is first added together into one combined reduction; a multiplier acts on that combined reduction as a whole. The renewal rate is the offered renewal rate less the combined reduction, the reduction acting once on the offered rate, never one reduction after another on a reduced rate.

**3. Rounding.** The renewal rate is rounded half up to two decimal places only at the end.

## Worked figures (hypothetical notices)

| Latest renewal notice | Offered renewal rate | Combined reduction (hypothetical) | Renewal rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| final options notice dated 2026-02-20, after an initial notice dated 2026-01-25 | 13.49 cents | none | 13.49 cents |
| initial renewal notice only | 12.88 cents | none | 12.88 cents |
| final options notice | 14.10 cents | 0.462 cents | 14.10 less 0.462 is 13.638, rounded to 13.64 cents |

In the last row the combined reduction is subtracted once from 14.10 cents and only the final figure is rounded.
